emergency_stop: Add oracle-eternal/PAUSED to the default branch, or disable the oracle-eternal workflow in GitHub Actions. Both work from an iPhone.
model_note: No model execution path is configured in First Light. The engine abstains from manuscript generation until Noah.Physical approves a model path and a spending limit.
pause_note: Set paused to true, or add an empty file named PAUSED next to this file, to stop scheduled execution. Resume by reversing either control. Disabling the workflow in the Actions tab also stops it.
storage_limit_note: State branch holds ledger, briefing, receipts, and artifacts only. No artifact over the word limit is saved without human review.
